"Hi Anand, welcome! It's great to finally meet you.  Thanks for coming in today. I've reviewed your resume and I'm particularly impressed with your projects, especially the Java-based Digital Mall system and the GameZork platform.  They showcase a nice range of skills.

To get started, could you please tell me a little bit about yourself?  I'd love to hear about your background, your interests within software development, and what excites you about this particular role (assuming there's a role description available)."

Anand, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today.  I've gained valuable insights into your experience and skills, and I appreciate you sharing your background with us.  The team will be reviewing all applications, and we'll be in touch to let you know the next steps in the hiring process.  We wish you all the best, and thank you again for your interest in [Company Name].
